data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to read proximity sensor events on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides a stream of proximity sensor changes and optional screen‑off behavior. It supports Android (min SDK 23) and iOS, handling necessary permissions and platform differences.
use_when: When you need proximity sensor data for UI or logic
When you want to turn off the screen while the device is close to a surface
When building AR, gaming or accessibility features that rely on proximity
avoid_when: When using Android versions below 12 if you need WAKE_LOCK permission
strengths: Simple API with a single Stream
Handles required permissions and platform quirks
weaknesses: Android 12+ needed for explicit exported activity
No support for virtual proximity sensors on some devices
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, add <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK"/> if using setProximityScreenOff(true). No build_runner needed.
